html: Masked Sobolev Training for Feasibility-Reliable Optimization Proxies accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 main track.
Completed a six-month visit to Pieter Abbeel’s Robot Learning Lab at UC Berkeley, working on policy learning and distillation for humanoid locomotion and dexterous manipulation.
Two papers at the NeurIPS 2025 ML×OR workshop: two-stage deep decision rules and DC2AC.
New preprint, A General and Streamlined Differentiable Optimization Framework, describing solution sensitivities for nonconvex programs, now in DiffOpt.jl.

ISyE 8803, Special Topics on Optimal Control and Learning, a student-led PhD course at Georgia Tech designed with Michael Klamkin, connects mathematical programming, optimal control and reinforcement learning.
Strategic bidding with gradient-based methods presented at IREP 2025 and published in Sustainable Energy, Grids and Networks.
Joined Los Alamos National Laboratory as a graduate researcher, working on solution sensitivities of optimization models and their use in learning.
Input-convex value functions presented at PSCC 2024 in Paris.
